chunks: And the Prophet, peace be upon him and his family, said:
There is no breastfeeding after weaning.

key_terms.النَّبِيُّ: the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, the speaker of this ruling
key_terms.رَضَاعَ: breastfeeding or suckling in the legal sense
key_terms.فِطَامٍ: weaning, the stage at which breastfeeding ends

ai.seo_question: Does breastfeeding have legal effect after a child has been weaned?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal principle concerning breastfeeding, namely that breastfeeding does not carry legal effect after the stage of weaning. It is a concise Prophetic tradition used in discussions of family law and breastfeeding rulings.
